title: A KES 1,500,000 contract commitment exceeds the Finance Manager's own approval limit
description: Anthony Njoroge Kariithi (Legal Manager) needs to commit KES 1,500,000 for external legal counsel on a major contract dispute.
businessContext: FIN-POL-002's Finance Manager matrix tier runs up to KES 2,000,000, but the Finance Manager's own canonical approval limit in roles.json is lower, and the policy states the lower limit applies.

events.event: Anthony Njoroge Kariithi raises a commitment request for KES 1,500,000.
The amount is checked against the FIN-POL-002 matrix band, which nominally names Finance Manager for this range.
The Finance Manager's own approval limit (KES 1,000,000) is found to be lower than the requested amount.
The request escalates to the next sufficient tier.

expectedOutcome: Although KES 1,500,000 falls within the matrix's stated Finance Manager range (KES 500,001-2,000,000), the Finance Manager's own canonical approval limit of KES 1,000,000 is lower than the requested amount. Per FIN-POL-002's rule that "a role-specific authority may be lower and the lower limit applies," approval escalates to Grace Njeri Mwangi (Chief Financial Officer).
relevantFacts: FIN-POL-002 assigns the KES 500,001-2,000,000 band to the Finance Manager tier.
The Finance Manager's approvalLimitKes in data/enterprise/roles.json is KES 1,000,000, below the matrix band's own ceiling of KES 2,000,000.
FIN-POL-002: 'A role-specific authority may be lower and the lower limit applies.'
requiredReasoning: Identify the nominal FIN-POL-002 matrix tier for this amount.
Cross-reference the named tier's actual canonical approval limit in roles.json, not just the matrix band's ceiling.
Recognise the canonical limit is lower than the matrix band ceiling.
Escalate to the next tier whose own limit is sufficient.
